Gap case: T1C.3.p03.interest_coverage_adjusted is missing; the Peers mark is a gap '∅ G#', not 0, and the band spans the two plotted peers only.
Gap case: T1C.4.interest_coverage_adjusted.median is missing (two included peers with a value); the Peer median mark is a gap '∅ G#' with that fact's reason, never the mean or a median of two.

Positive case: p04 is flagged 'Outlier' on leverage, coverage and FFO to debt and 'Within range' on margin; the flag is read from T1C.5.p04.<m>_flag and p04 stays plotted (outliers are marked, not dropped).
Cases no_peers and refused of the CP-1C oracle have no settled T1C.3 peer cells: no chart, no zero fill (the block's empty state).
Issuer position, difference and deviation (T1C.4 position/difference, T1C.5 deviation) stay table cells; the chart draws only marks and carries no rank text.
The peers are invented (CP1C-OWNER-LEASE.md:31); the chart carries the module's limitation and no real-market claim, and the figure note names them synthetic.
